title: MatMix Solo #34 (새 재질 솔로 · 옻칠 흑칠 · 체형 hourglass bombshell · 인종 Slavic · 메이크업 잉크 블랙립(강화) · 배경 기자 피라미드(화창한 낮) · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, mid 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, blunt bob honey blonde hair — full body glossy black urushi lacquer fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid lacquered curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted lacquer sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING mirror-black urushi lacquer across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID gold maki-e waves, pines and moons between the sections, with carved relief of waves across the surface of every section, mirror-gloss lacquered, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of the same lacquer, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, made of the same lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT lacquer — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Russian woman with high cheekbones, light eyes and a defined jaw, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a blurred ink-black gradient across the lids like soft smoke, a fine black liner, natural full lashes, a glass-skin highlight on the cheekbones, ink-black glossy lips with a softly blurred gradient edge.

Background: the sandy Giza plateau with the great pyramids behind her, a smooth flat sand path and a standard-height stone doorway block at her side, empty of tourists, in clear sunny daylight, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
